newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW - Scotia could win cancer race.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Scotia could win cancer race.

text.p: Drug discovery group Scotia Holdings Plc said on Tuesday it could win the race to be first to market with a new generation of ground-breaking cancer drugs.

In a telephone interview with Reuters, chief executive David Horrobin said Scotia aims to submit its EF13 pancreatic cancer drug to regulators by the end of 1997, "and depending on how quickly they react it could be (approved) next year or in the first half of 1998."
Horrobin said Phase III trials show EF13 "is at least as good" as rival British Biotech Plc's potential blockbuster Marimastat.
